note: Vendored legality data. Per DECK-FORMATS.md §2.6: vendored JSON is the authority; scrapers only ever propose a diff for human review. A confidently-wrong ban list silently breaks decks, so every list below carries its source and an 'as of' date. Refresh with the sync jobs described in DECK-FORMATS §2.6 (J1-J7).

formats.json.derived_from: DECK-FORMATS.md §2.1.2 / §3.8 + live deckscout DB (format, format_regulation_mark tables, seeded).
formats.json.authority: The DB `format` + `format_regulation_mark` tables are also authoritative and agree with this file. This file is the offline mirror the validator uses so it needs no DB round-trip for format knobs.
formats.json.current_standard_marks: H, I, J (DECK-FORMATS §2.1.2, sources S1+S3). G rotated out 2026-04-10.
formats.json.todo: Next rotation ~2027-04-09 (H drops, K enters). Re-verify after reading the January 2027 rotation announcement. Treat legality computed after 2027-04-01 as stale until then.

banlist-standard.json.fetched: DECK-FORMATS.md §2.1.4 (as of 2026-07-24). Empty today: 'No cards are currently banned in the Standard format.'

banlist-expanded.json.fetched: DECK-FORMATS.md §2.2 (as of 2026-07-24). 27 print-scoped entries transcribed verbatim from the spec.
banlist-expanded.json.confidence: HIGH for the entries that name a specific set+number. Set-id mapping (name -> tcgdex set) done by hand; a couple of pre-SM set ids should be spot-checked against the DB before production use.

banlist-glc.json.fetched: DECK-FORMATS.md §2.3.5 (as of 2026-07-24). 13 entries. 'Double Colorless Energy' is the one NAME-scoped ban ('and all other versions').

ace-spec.json.sv_era: DERIVED from the live deckscout DB: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM card WHERE rarity='ACE SPEC Rare' (29 names, verified 2026-07-27). TCGdex has no ACE SPEC field (DECK-FORMATS §3.5) so this rarity scan is the seed the spec recommends.
ace-spec.json.bw_xy_era: VENDORED from public documentation (Bulbapedia 'ACE SPEC card' category). BW/XY ACE SPEC Trainers carry no 'ACE SPEC Rare' rarity and no 'ACE SPEC' effect text in TCGdex, so they cannot be derived from the DB. FLAGGED: this sub-list is the least certain data in the module (DECK-FORMATS §7 item 7 rates it 'High impact'). Verify before trusting Expanded legality of a BW/XY ACE SPEC.
ace-spec.json.todo: Extend once per set. Re-run the rarity scan after each SV/ME set sync.

ptcgl-set-alias.json.derived_from: Hand-authored from the live DB set list joined to PTCGL codes (DECK-FORMATS §1.7). Seeded by tcgOnline where present, corrected for the collisions tcgOnline creates (CRZ tcgOnline points at the Galarian Gallery, not main Crown Zenith) and extended across the SM/SWSH/SV/ME eras which tcgOnline does not cover at all.
ptcgl-set-alias.json.me_era_codes: PFL/ASC/POR/CRI/PBL added 2026-07-30 from limitlesstcg.com/cards (set index) and cross-verified two ways: (1) chasedex.com/guides/pokemon-tcg-set-codes; (2) per-card number matches in real 2026 tournament decklists (NAIC 2026 list 28249: Meowth ex POR 62, Telepathic Psychic Energy POR 88 = our me03-088; JP Championships 2026 list 28729: Dhelmise PBL 39/Gwynn PBL 78/Prism Tower CRI 80 = our me05-039/me05-078/me04-080). The DB card_set.ptcgl_code column is NOT the authority — it is TCGdex tcgOnline (abandoned at 2023-01, collides, and the sync's ON CONFLICT would overwrite any backfill), so the exporter reads only this file.
ptcgl-set-alias.json.live_flag: live:false marks codes that exist in decklist vocabulary (Limitless/PTCGO) but whose sets are NOT in PTCG Live's card pool. Pool floor = Sun & Moon series: Live's 'Expanded (Beta)' format 'only allows cards printed from Sun & Moon onwards' (Bulbapedia 'Expanded format (TCG)', checked 2026-07-30). The exporter substitutes a fingerprint-identical Live-pool reprint or emits a bare-name line + warning for live:false / unmapped sets.
ptcgl-set-alias.json.coverage: Covers the codes in the three fixture decklists plus the common modern pool, all SV/ME-era sets, and every set in the user's decks. Unmapped pseudo-sets (SWSHALT/SVALT/SMALT, SVOM, MBD, ...) resolve via the name-only fallback ladder (§1.7.2 step 5). Sets older than BW (WOTC/ex/DP/HGSS eras, McDonald's, trainer kits, TCG Pocket) deliberately have NO entry: no PTCGL code exists, so the exporter warns instead of inventing one.
ptcgl-set-alias.json.tcgplayer_abbrev: Mostly null. Mass Entry uses a THIRD namespace (TCGplayer abbrevs from TCGCSV group data, §1.9) which is not vendored here; populate from the price feed when the buy-links feature lands.
